title: Gradient Glow & Gradient Bevel filters: gradient editor UI + render + SWF encode
description: Implement Gradient Glow and Gradient Bevel filters per docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md. FIRST verify current filter support in packages/authoring-ui/src/FiltersPanel.tsx and the filter model/render path. Scope: (1) when a Gradient Glow/Bevel filter is added, FiltersPanel shows a multi-stop gradient editor (color+alpha+ratio per stop, add/remove stops) plus the standard blur/strength/quality/angle/distance/knockout/type controls; (2) stage renderer (packages/core engine renderer) approximates the gradient filter via an offscreen/composite pass blending across stops (not just brightest stop); (3) SWF encode the GRADIENTGLOWFILTER/GRADIENTBEVELFILTER records via PlaceObject3 in packages/swf. Primary files: packages/authoring-ui/src/FiltersPanel.tsx, packages/core engine renderer + filter model, packages/swf compiler (filters/characters). DONE = author can add+edit gradient filters, stage shows gradient blend, SWF round-trips the filter record (unit test), typecheck + 3 unit suites green. Update docs/08 if detail changes.
